components.name: Button + Payment - Pattern

rules: Button + Payment - Pattern is the only correct way to surface the active payment method selector — do not build a custom payment button from raw button components.

components.name: Redirection loader

properties.name: Label
properties.notes: Descriptive text shown below the loader — always replace with context-appropriate copy (e.g. Redirecting to biller…)

components.name: List + body text
components.description: List of items each accompanied by a body text description — placed inside a Bottom Sheet slot. Typical uses include plan details, feature breakdowns, or step-by-step instructions.

properties.name: Count
properties.notes: Number of list rows with body text to display

use_cases.context: Showing a list of items each accompanied by a body text description inside a Bottom Sheet slot
use_cases.config: When placed inside a Bottom Sheet, use a slot (not a slot container) so the sheet height adjusts to the content

rules: List + body text can be placed wherever a list with body text is needed — in a Bottom Sheet slot, a screen section, or any other layout context.
Use the smallest Count value that accurately represents the number of items — do not pad with empty rows.

components.name: Account Management - Pattern
components.description: Linked bank account or RuPay card card in the account management screen. Handles collapsed/expanded state, primary account designation, balance visibility, and biometric auth status.

properties.name: Type
properties.notes: The type of linked account

properties.name: Open
properties.notes: Whether the account card is expanded to show full details

properties.name: Primary
properties.notes: Whether this is the user's primary payment account. Only applicable to Type=Bank — RuPay accounts are always non-primary

properties.name: Balance
properties.notes: Whether the account balance is visible

properties.name: isBioauth Enabled
properties.notes: Whether biometric authentication is enabled for this account

variants.name: Bank
variants.semantic_use: Bank accounts can be set as primary (Primary=True available)

variants.name: RuPay
variants.semantic_use: RuPay cards are never the primary account — always use Primary=False

use_cases.context: Displaying a linked bank account or RuPay card in the account management screen
Displaying a linked RuPay card in the account management screen

rules: Primary=True is only valid for Type=Bank — never set Primary=True on a RuPay account.
Use Open=True only for the currently selected or active account card. All other cards in the list should default to Open=False.
Balance=True should reflect whether the user has chosen to reveal their balance — mirror the actual visibility state, do not default to visible.

components.name: QR - Card
components.description: QR code display card on the Profile QR screen. Use Card=QR Code for a standard scannable QR and Card=Amount - QR Code when a preset amount is embedded in the QR.

properties.name: Card
properties.notes: Type of QR card — standard or amount-prefixed

properties.name: Buttons
properties.notes: Number of action buttons below the QR. Plenty = 3 or more

use_cases.context: Displaying the user's UPI QR code on the Profile QR screen for general receive-money flows
Displaying a QR with a specific payment amount being requested

rules: Use QR - Card with Card=Amount - QR Code only when a specific payment amount is being requested — for general receive-money flows, use Card=QR Code.
Buttons=Plenty accommodates 3 or more action buttons below the QR card. Use Buttons=2 for the standard two-button layout.
